Is a second-hand field robot a viable investment?

 05-10 | Field robots | Article

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

Used field robots are gradually entering the market, particularly from long-established manufacturers such as AgXeed, FarmDroid, H2L Robotics, Naïo and SwarmFarm Robotics. Examples include machines from rental fleets being offered as demo units or used equipment. René Koerhuis, Gerrit Kurstjens, Mark Pasveer, Peter Roek.

 Is a second-hand field robot worthwhile to consider for farmers, contractors and orchard owners looking for a (more) affordable autonomous option? As an introduction into robotic operations or as a cheaper addition to an existing fleet? This is what dealers and manufacturers say. With some field robots having been commercially deployed for multiple years, a second-hand market is (slowly) arising. translationZh:
二手田间机器人正逐渐进入市场，尤其是来自AgXeed、FarmDroid、H2L Robotics、Naïo和SwarmFarm Robotics等老牌制造商的设备。例如，来自租赁车队的机器被作为演示样机或二手设备出售。René Koerhuis、Gerrit Kurstjens、Mark Pasveer、Peter Roek。

对于寻求（更）经济实惠的自主化方案的农户、承包商和果园主来说，二手田间机器人是否值得考虑？作为进入机器人作业的入门途径，还是作为现有车队的更便宜补充？这是经销商和制造商们的看法。随着一些田间机器人已经商业化部署多年，二手市场正在（缓慢地）形成。实际上，二手市场将会——或者说可能——以类似的方式出现、运作和演变。

René Koerhuis 精准农业专家
